name: Plot Problem Evaluation
description: Part of the Story Genius Method, this scene template is designed to help you evaluate whether or not a plot idea you have is right for your story.

attributes.name: Is the problem capable of forcing my character to make the inner change that my novel is actually about?
Will the problem force my character to struggle with their misbelief?
Will the approaching consequence cost my character something big emotionally speaking even if he/she doesn't achieve their goal?
